# sonarqube_application (Resource)

Provides a Sonarqube Application resource. An application groups several projects into one view. Applications are only available in the Developer edition and above.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sonarqube_project" "api" {
  name       = "Payments API"
  project    = "payments-api"
  visibility = "private"
}

resource "sonarqube_project" "web" {
  name       = "Payments Web"
  project    = "payments-web"
  visibility = "private"
}

resource "sonarqube_application" "payments" {
  key         = "payments"
  name        = "Payments"
  description = "Everything that makes up the payments product"
  visibility  = "private"
  projects    = [sonarqube_project.api.project, sonarqube_project.web.project]
  tags        = ["payments", "team-a"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Key of the application. Changing it creates a new application.
- `name` (String) Name of the application.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the application.
- `projects` (Set of String) Keys of the projects in the application.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags of the application.
- `visibility` (String) Whether the application is `public` or `private`. Defaults to SonarQube's default visibility.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an application by its key
terraform import sonarqube_application.example my-application-key
```
